manual_step_requirements.action: Open the appropriate stock compartment and separate supported items into labeled tray slots
Secure sheets, tubes and fragile films in compatible retainers
Grasp the carrier's structural handles, close retainers and lift clear of source supports
Seat and secure the carrier at the destination before releasing the grasp
Place aluminum track stock onto the water-jet bed and fasten its supports
Set the work origin and load the site/date-specific track job through the machine interface
Start the loaded track program from the machine control interface
Release the accessible bed clamps while supporting the cut track and surrounding stock
Lift the cut track into its supported carrier and segregate offcuts
Deburr the supported edges using the selected compatible finishing tool
Clean the supported disk using the selected compatible surface-preparation procedure
Mask the back and fixture contact region, then place the disk on a coating support
Prepare the identified spray can and remove its cap at the coating station
Aim and sweep the nozzle over the supported optical face using the selected coating card
Release the nozzle, replace the cap and return the can to its assigned storage
Place the acrylic base, rails, foam layers, support tube, ring and shield in assembly order
Seat the acrylic base on a stable assembly fixture and attach the framing rails
Attach the base shielding and position the lower foam disk
Place the second 25 mm foam disk above the first and inspect the stack
Grasp the disk at its qualified edge and seat it on the insulation stack
Lower the PE support tube around the stack without contacting the emitter edge or leads
Support the spacer ring in a film jig and prepare its lower attachment face
Present the lower sheet with edge supports and attach it to the first ring face
Turn the supported ring using the jig, then present and attach the second sheet
Trim excess film outside the retained annulus using the selected cutting support
Wrap the prescribed lateral support and base surfaces with aluminized Mylar
Keep the cover ring retained by its jig while lowering the lower film onto the PE tube rim; inspect the selected membrane-supported load path before releasing the jig
Lower the polished aluminum cylinder over the assembly without trapping sensor leads
Fit the aperture plate and align its 50 mm opening with the emitter
Attach the two hollow support rods to the framing and set their selected height datum
Fasten the site/date track between the supported rods
Install the 60 mm reflector disk on its movable carriage
Grasp the bath lid by its handle, lift it clear and seat it on its stand
Close the drain and secure the installed bath plumbing connections
Seat the copper block in its lifting cradle and lower it onto its bath support
Grasp the identified water vessel, pour into the reservoir and stop at the installed controller's fill range with the block present
For each probe, grip its sheath or retained junction support, align the assigned hole and insert to the declared immersion position
Route and connect the reference RTD leads to the selected Keithley2000 input configuration
Install the selected K-compatible transition/extension on each probe pair and retain its strain relief
For each K-probe pair, identify CnH/CnL, loosen the two terminal screws with the selected driver and retain the conductors
Insert each positive and negative conductor into its assigned wire entry, then tighten its screw while retaining the wire
Apply the qualified retention check to each terminated wire and secure cable strain relief
Connect the USB cable, select K-type channel-pair configuration in the installed software and enable open-channel checks
Enter one supplied bath setpoint through the installed circulator controls
Seat and latch the whole assembly on the bench support
Support the installed track/disk or band, release its mounting fasteners and seat it on its labeled stand
Lift the aperture plate by its rim and return it to its stand; then lift the shield while guiding leads clear
Engage the cover-ring jig before lifting the complete two-film cover onto its support
Lift the PE tube to its stand, then support and lift the emitter by its edge with the probe route clear
Seat the emitter in the reversible edge-support jig and expose its backside
Clean the selected backside contact patch with the declared compatible preparation tool
Dispense the selected silver paste onto the contact patch using the metered applicator
Pick the identified calibrated probe by its support, align the junction near the backside center and retain it in contact
Secure lead strain relief and route the lead through the declared exit
Turn the retained emitter face-up and reseat it on the insulation support
Restore the PE support tube around the emitter and inspect the lead exit
Lower the jig-retained cover onto the support rim and inspect its declared support/load path
Seat the shield and aperture plate while guiding all leads through retained exits
Reinstall and fasten the identified track/disk or band on its support mounts
Stop acquisition and put the instrument into the required accessory-change state
Open the installed sample lid or door along its supported access path
If changing accessories, support and remove the previous accessory to its stand, then seat and secure the selected accessory on its locating base
For the selected IntegratIR, align and seat the keyed detector cable, then connect the declared purge arrangement if required
Remove the reference protective cap and place the identified reference at the selected instrument's reference port
Set the reference/sample selector, required port plugs and specular configuration for the chosen method
Close the required sample access without disturbing the reference or detector lead
Restore required power, select the detector/source and background settings, and start the reference after the required warm-up
Open the sample access after acquisition has stopped
For a substitution route, lift the reference by its nonoptical rim, replace its cap and seat it in its nest
Open the empty holder latch while retaining the holder
Pick the specimen by allowed edges, align its face with the measurement plane and seat it against the locating surfaces
Close the holder retention feature and release the gripper after the seating check
Close the required access cover and retract the manipulator
Select the specimen identity and supplied scan settings
Issue the scan-start command through the bound instrument interface
Stop the previous scan and establish the instrument's accessory-access state
Open the sample compartment and inspect its current occupancy
When the accessory differs, support it, release its connections and retainers, and return it to its stand
Seat and secure the Harrick12 or SpectraTech variable-angle accessory appropriate to this incidence angle
Seat and retain the identified white or black specimen at the declared optical plane
Release the angle lock if adjustable, set the bound incidence angle and resecure the lock
Install or rotate the selected polarizer to the bound s or p orientation and retain its mount
Start the identified sample's angular scan using the bound settings
Seat and retain the two devices by their robust bases at separate supports
Orient each frame and adjust the reflector supports using observed solar geometry
Route sensor and heater leads to protected instruments with strain relief
Mount the exposed-element ambient RTD inside the ventilated radiation shield
Inspect and connect the HOBO U30 weather-station sensors and power
Mount and level the EKO STR-32G and connect MS-56 and MS-402 on its sensor supports
Check tracker location/time configuration and initiate its automatic sun tracking
Place USB-TC in its reflective protective enclosure and route leads through retained exits
Configure each acquisition stream's supplied cadence and channel map
Place an identified aluminum lid over each aperture while retaining both PE films
Start the paired temperature acquisition and record the baseline start time
Lift the first lid and place it on its assigned support
Lift the second lid and place it on its separate support
Release the carriage retainer while supporting the disk carriage
Slide the carriage along the computed track and secure it at the new position
Seat and latch the whole assembly on the bench support
Support the installed track/disk or band, release its mounting fasteners and seat it on its labeled stand
Lift the aperture plate by its rim and return it to its stand; then lift the shield while guiding leads clear
Engage the cover-ring jig before lifting the complete two-film cover onto its support
Lift the PE tube clear, support the emitter by its edge and seat it backside-up in the reversible jig
Prepare the underside attachment region and apply the selected attachment layer
Grip the heater at its allowed edge, align its lead exit and seat it against the supported disk
Identify the two heater nodes and connect distinct force and sense leads at each node
Strain-relieve the leads and connect them to the selected source meter's FORCE/SENSE terminals with output off
Turn the jig-retained emitter face-up, seat it on the inspected insulation and restore the PE tube
Lower the jig-retained cover onto the support rim and inspect its declared support/load path
Seat the shield and aperture plate while guiding all leads through retained exits
Reinstall and fasten the identified track/disk or band on its support mounts
Load the selected PID configuration and verify its sensor/heater association
Command one bound temperature target and verify feedback selection
Command both heater outputs off and read back their actual state
Seat and latch the whole assembly on the bench support
Support the installed track/disk or band, release its mounting fasteners and seat it on its labeled stand
Lift the aperture plate by its rim and return it to its stand; then lift the shield while guiding leads clear
Engage the cover-ring jig before lifting the complete two-film cover onto its support
Keep the cover ring in its jig and release the two nanoporous films using the qualified attachment-release method
Retain the identified LDPE bag stock flat, cut two sheets with outside attachment margins and retain the offcuts
Attach the first LDPE sheet to one ring face while its outer margins remain supported
Turn the jig-retained ring, attach the second sheet to the opposite face and trim excess outside the attachment
Lower the jig-retained cover onto the support rim and inspect its declared support/load path
Seat the shield and aperture plate while guiding all leads through retained exits
Reinstall and fasten the identified track/disk or band on its support mounts
Seat and latch the whole assembly on the bench support
Support the installed track/disk or band, release its mounting fasteners and seat it on its labeled stand
Lift the aperture plate by its rim and return it to its stand; then lift the shield while guiding leads clear
Engage the cover-ring jig before lifting the complete two-film cover onto its support
On supported removable insulation, form the selected probe recess and lead relief for the near-axis internal point and layer-interface point
Expose each required surface while retaining displaced parts, then prepare its declared contact patch
For each of the six probes, apply the surface-compatible attachment and retain the junction at its declared location
Secure each lead to its assigned route and strain relief before restoring displaced parts
With acquisition stopped, seat and clamp each probe pair's qualified transition leads at its allocated CnH/CnL terminals
Lower the jig-retained cover onto the support rim and inspect its declared support/load path
Seat the shield and aperture plate while guiding all leads through retained exits
Reinstall and fasten the identified track/disk or band on its support mounts
Start synchronized acquisition for the emitter and all six installed additional sensors
Stop active scans, motion and heater outputs through the actual station interfaces
Disconnect accessible isolated leads at the identified terminals and coil them
Support each sample or assembly before releasing its station retainers
Seat each object on its labeled storage support and release the carrier retainers
Return tools, unused materials and detachable accessories to identified supports
Separate offcuts, damaged films and coating residues according to their actual material procedures
Stop the bath sweep and request the declared removal condition
Retain the block, withdraw each probe by its body and place it in its labeled drip/drying support
After stopping acquisition, support each K wire, loosen its screw and withdraw the conductor
Disconnect the reference RTD at its connector and coil its supported lead
Lift the block with its cradle, allow drainage over the reservoir and seat it in the drying tray
Retrieve and seat the bath lid without trapping leads
Stop acquisition and confirm access is permitted
Open the sample access while retaining its cover
Grip the specimen by its allowed edges before releasing the holder latch
Lift the specimen clear and seat it in its labeled carrier
Restore the declared port plugs and protected reference storage state
Close sample access without a trapped lead or specimen
Remove masking without touching or peeling the optical face
Release the disk from its support and return it to the identified edge-supported carrier
Seat the copper blank against the selected fixture datums and tighten its clamps
Fit the selected drill and align the work origin with the marked hole layout
For each hole, set the bound depth stop and start the installed drilling control
With tool motion stopped, clear chips and finish each supported hole edge
Support the block, release its clamps and place it in its labeled carrier
Clamp the copper/aluminum blank or retain the polymer sheets in a supported cutting jig
Cut the specimen profile with the material-appropriate qualified tool, retaining both film layers separately where required
Finish and clean metal edges or fit the two film layers to the declared optical carrier
Support the specimen, release its holder and place it in its labeled nest
Seat the qualified angular reference at the same optical plane and retain it
Close the required sample access for reference acquisition
Select the angular-reference settings and start acquisition
Reopen sample access after the acquisition stops
Support and release the reference, return it to its nest and replace its protective cover
Restore and retain the identified sample at the unchanged optical plane
Close sample access without changing angle or polarization
Seat and latch the whole assembly on the bench support
Support the installed track/disk or band, release its mounting fasteners and seat it on its labeled stand
Lift the aperture plate by its rim and return it to its stand; then lift the shield while guiding leads clear
Engage the cover-ring jig before lifting the complete two-film cover onto its support
Remove the PE tube and transfer the emitter to its backside-access jig without loading the probe wire
With outputs verified off, support and disconnect force/sense connectors and retain each lead pair
Use the selected release tool to separate the heater while retaining it and the emitter independently
Remove the attachment residue with the qualified compatible method and collect the residue
Reseat the emitter on inspected insulation and restore its PE support tube
Lower the jig-retained cover onto the support rim and inspect its declared support/load path
Seat the shield and aperture plate while guiding all leads through retained exits
Reinstall and fasten the identified track/disk or band on its support mounts
Fixture the identified copper and aluminum blanks and cut the disk, ring and aperture profiles
Clamp the aluminum tube, cut its shield section and finish its supported edges
Fixture and cut the PE support tube using the selected compatible machine
Cut and drill the supported acrylic base and fit its framing fasteners
Cut two separate foam disks per device using a supported template and guided cutter
Pick the allocated stock into separate supported carriers and identify both sheets for each film pair
Seat and latch the whole assembly on the bench support
Support the installed track/disk or band, release its mounting fasteners and seat it on its labeled stand
Lift the aperture plate by its rim and return it to its stand; then lift the shield while guiding leads clear
Engage the cover-ring jig before lifting the complete two-film cover onto its support
Place the removed LDPE cover in its labeled retained storage and retrieve an inspected two-layer nanoporous cover
Lower the jig-retained cover onto the support rim and inspect its declared support/load path
Seat the shield and aperture plate while guiding all leads through retained exits
Reinstall and fasten the identified track/disk or band on its support mounts
